posts.author: Dachimotsu
posts.body:
I'm making an 8-bit style RPG with a smaller native resolution than normal. After arguing with ChatGPT for a few hours, I've managed to get a plugin working that gives me a custom resolution that doesn't blur any of the graphics when stretched to full-screen. However, even after making and importing in a new, pixelated, 12-point font (using Yanfly Engine Core) and trying several different plugins (both AI- and human-made), the in-game text is still blurry.
I'm not sure what else to do. I need all the graphics in the game to scale via Nearest-Neighbor in order to maintain the NES palette.

Hi!
You need to put something on the Font Face in the plugin parameter. It's like an ID.
The plugin parameter "All Characters" is empty. It should be filled according to the font bitmap file you created.
The bitmap font image is not properly configured. It must be an image with a single row. Your image has 6 rows.
In the same place you download the plugin, there is a sample project. Take a look at it regarding the bitmap font. See how the plugin parameters are configured and also how the bitmap font is created under the system folder.

On the left side is your rpg_windows.js file. And on the right side is the original rpg_windows.js file:
The line height, font size, standard padding and text padding are different.
After I copy and pasted the original codes into your project, and set Yanfly and line width fix plugin to OFF the 4 lines show as usual.
So the problem was:
- Your rpg_windows.js was not the same as the original, it had some changes on it.
- Either yanfly core compatibility issue, or yanfly core changes some text/line settings that was causing to show only two lines.
- Compatibility with the plugin line width fix

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Dachimotsu said:
I appreciate the help, and I don't mean to sound ungrateful, but it still doesn't look completely fixed. The message box takes up almost the whole screen with those huge gaps between each line.
Click to expand...
The default line height of the message window, from the Window_Base is 36.
Your font height is 18.
That difference is what is causing the huge gaps.
Let's take a look from a 816x624 resoltion, just to be easier to see.
This is the default font, size 28, with the default line height of 36:
This is the bitmap font, with height of 18 and message window with line height 36:
- The gaps are here, because of the difference between the font height and line height.
Now, let's change the line height of the message window to 18, as you had changed with the yanfly plugin.
This is the default font, size 28, with the default line height of 18:
- Changing the line height to 18, changes the message box size.
This is the bitmap font, with height of 18 and message window with line height 18:
The thing is, what made the gaps are the difference between line height and font height/size. Higher the difference, higher the gaps.
How to fix this? Reduce the difference. There is nothing wrong with the plugin, it is working as expected. The "problem" is a matter of configuration. From the line height and from the bitmap font height.
On your project, you had changed the line height from several points:
- Yanfly plugin
- rpg_windows
- line width fix
My advise would change that only with yanfly.
take a look at a bitmap font height 18 and window line height of 22:
- It's start to looking better!
With your own resolution:
So try tweak the line height size(or the bitmap font height) until you find a size where everything displays the way you like. Also, if you are aiming for a pixel perfect, your game resolution must also be pixel perfect. 426x240 is not. Because 426/48 = 8,875. But 240/48 = 5, so works fine.
